turns.text: Hey Lloyd, did you get a chance to look at the build logs for the new microservice? The CI is hanging on the integration tests again.
I checked the logs. It looks like a timeout in the database connection pool. Have you tried increasing the `pool_size` in the config file?
I bumped it to 50 already. Still stuck. Ugh, I spent the morning debugging this instead of finishing the report. Also, did the delivery arrive for the new mechanical keyboard switches?
The tracking info says out for delivery, so it should be there by this afternoon. As for the CI, check if the test containers are cleaning up properly after each run.

Good catch, I'll check the teardown scripts. Speaking of optimization, I was reading that article by Dex Horthy earlier. He argues that chasing 100x speedup leads to the 'meta-meta problem of optimization' and prevents achieving a pragmatic 10x gain.
That's a common trap. Focusing too much on the extreme edge cases often ignores the systemic bottlenecks that give you the easier, larger wins.
Exactly. I think we're over-engineering the cache layer for that reason. Anyway, do you want to grab lunch later? That new Thai place on 4th?
Sure, I can join you at 12:30. I'll keep an eye on the CI status while you check the teardown scripts.
